The second handback asked me to fix a merge conflict that no longer exists. PR #234 is waiting on CI, so I've stopped.

- **Already merged:** the branch head `8f1c1e4728` already contains master's current head `458bd186c4`. It is 23 commits ahead and none behind.
- **No conflict:** a test merge of master into the branch comes out clean, and GitHub marks the PR mergeable.
- **Resolved last attempt:** the conflict in `nv2a_index.json` was fixed in attempt 5 by regenerating the index. The index check and preflight passed then.
- **Likely a misread:** the handback fired seven minutes after CI started on this head. The fold job probably read the pending checks plus the leftover `needs-rebase` label as a failed merge.

I didn't push anything, because a new commit would restart CI. The two `build` checks were still running when I stopped. I posted the explanation as a `[lane.vshconst] waiting:` comment on the PR: https://github.com/jreinach-alt/hakuX/pull/234#issuecomment-5833524090.

`NOTES.md` is unchanged. Its attempt-5 entry already describes this wait. It doesn't say why attempt 5 didn't finish, which the resume asked for; the comment carries that, and adding it would mean a commit that restarts CI.

The PR is already marked ready. When the builds pass, run `gh-label.sh rm 234 needs-rebase` and `gh-label.sh add 234 fold-ready`. The handback job will resume the lane to do it, or whoever sees green first can run them.
